column1: # Commercial health spending per member in California rose 7.8% in 2024, more than twice the state's 3.5% yearly target that began in 2025.

# Source: California Department of Health Care Access and Information (HCAI), Office of Health Care Affordability, Health Care Spending Trends in California, 2023-2024 (2026-10-07). Per member per year: $6,984 in 2023, $7,532 in 2024. The target applies from 2025, so 2024 spending was not held to it. Targets: 2025 3.5%, 2026 3.5%, 2027 3.2%, 2028 3.2%, 2029 3.0%.

column3: Commercial spending per member, 2023 to 2024: +7.8% ($6,984 to $7,532)
